description: Land Title Settlement Department - Wannarpanni North West, Nullur D/S Division, Jaffna District - Cad. Map No. 910012 (23/1200185)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters, specifically calling for claims to land parcels in various districts under the Registration of Title Act.
